{{Top|leg}}
'''Zietta's Palace''' was the home of [[Zietta Anjiliac|Zietta the Hutt]]. It was located in the Ministry Precinct of [[Point Nadir]]. It was modeled after a sprawling subterranean rock garden and was one of the most extravagant estates in Point Nadir.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
